_comment: X accounts the Demand Radar watches (radar_x.py), organized in lanes. Radar batches them into from:-OR searches with a min_faves floor, so we only pay for tweets that are ALREADY viral - adding accounts is nearly free. Edit freely, no code change needed. OWNER DOCTRINE (Aug 1, permanent): follow accounts that SUMMARIZE each world (AI, robotics, space, markets, breaking tech) - not company/CEO roll calls. Company virals (SpaceX launches, robot demos) are caught by the wide-net topic+video searches in radar_x.py, so company accounts earn a slot only if their OWN tweets go viral (sama/elonmusk/OpenAI-class). Markets lane added Aug 1 (owner: investment world - Citadel/Situational Awareness, Buffett, Wall St drama).
